source_role: Mozilla's original MathML font-encoding investigation, the manufacturer's font-encoding documentation, and Microsoft's font identity metadata.
scope: Two standalone character correspondences only. No font file, outline or copied mapping table. Font variants can have different glyph IDs: every use must independently match the embedded Microsoft Symbol cmap, PDF Identity CID-to-GID map and ToUnicode, rather than a hard-coded glyph index. Names alone are insufficient.
excluded: Bracket assembly pieces, accents, arrows, missing glyphs and all other positions remain unresolved. Do not apply Adobe Symbol's Kappa/lambda meanings to MT Extra.
